mapper.select: SELECT t.display_name FROM tags t JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE pt.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY t.tag_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tags (display_name, normalized_name) VALUES (#{displayName}, #{normalizedName}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = VALUES(display_name)
INSERT IGNORE INTO post_tags (post_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{tagId})
